data_cache.beta_method: RESOLVED 2026-07-28 (G15): betas computed vs SMH (the book's true factor, not SPX) from 20 daily returns, 25 Jun - 24 Jul 2026. CAVEAT: a 20-observation window carries wide standard errors -- treat these as ordinal (which names are high- vs low-beta) rather than precise point estimates, and refresh to a 60-day window on the next deep run. data_cache.sentiment_method: RESOLVED-IN-PART 2026-07-28 (G17). Findings: (a) 52-week high/low from WEEKLY bars is EXACT, not an approximation -- a weekly high is by construction the max of that week's daily highs, so the 52wk range component never had an error; (b) RSI14 must use TRUE DAILY closes -- the weekly-aggregated version read 53.12 against a true daily 35.81, a 17.3-point error that materially misstated the composite; (c) the 125-day MA still uses weekly closes, a genuine but small smoothing approximation. METHOD: indices auto-aggregate to weekly for period>=3mo; use period='1mo' with at most 3 symbols per call to force daily bars. RSI14 needs only 15 daily closes, so one 1mo call suffices.

cache_policy.rationale: A quick run was costing ~119KB of raw API payload (~33k tokens), of which 18 of 27 calls were avoidable. ATR20, betas and earnings dates are slow-moving; re-pulling them every run is the single largest waste.
cache_policy.refresh_rule: On a QUICK run, read every cache as-is; refresh nothing. On a DEEP run, refresh only entries whose TTL has expired. ATR20 over a 20-day window drifts roughly 5% per week -- weekly refresh is ample, and a stale ATR makes stops slightly wide, which is the safe direction to be wrong.
cache_policy.price_source_rule: Live prices: use yfinance get_stock_price (232 chars/symbol). Use INDmoney get_us_stocks_details (726 chars/symbol, 3.1x heavier) ONLY when market_session is pre-open and ext_hr_live_price is genuinely needed. get_stock_price already carries price, prev_close and day high/low -- everything the stop framework consumes.
cache_policy.session_reuse: Do not re-pull prices for the same symbol within 20 minutes unless the user asks for a fresh check or a stop level is being placed.

themes.name: China semiconductor self-sufficiency
themes.watch: DUV/EUV progress, CXMT, SMIC, Hua Hong, YMTC, export-control changes
themes.live_2026_07_28: China began mass-producing immersion DUV; 5 units 2026, ~20 in 2027, vs ASML 131 immersion tools 2025 and 98.7% share. Does not touch EUV.
themes.live_2026_07_30: De-escalating not resolved: sell-side (Jefferies/Bernstein/UBS) reframes CXMT as 2027+ risk, not immediate share-taking

themes.name: Memory pricing & competition
themes.watch: HBM/DRAM/NAND contract and spot pricing, Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron capacity, CXMT supply
themes.live_2026_07_28: CXMT listed on Shanghai STAR +400% debut. Named, capitalised domestic Chinese competitor where there was none. Hand to HBMTracker.
themes.live_2026_07_30: Same de-escalation; QCOM flagged as a new cross-factor short on memory-price inflation squeezing handset margins
themes.live_2026_07_31: SK Hynix Q2: record YoY (+257% rev) but missed Street consensus on delayed HBM4 shipments -- beat-and-miss simultaneously. Goldman still sees double-digit DRAM price growth into 2027. CXMT/DUV threat from 07-28 unaddressed by today's news.
themes.live_2026_08_03: KOSPI/Samsung/SK Hynix give back ~1/3 of 07-31's record rally on profit-taking + leverage unwind, not new fundamental news. CXMT DUV ceiling now visible in LPDDR6 spec (12.8 vs 14.4 Gbps, techtimes 08-02).
themes.live_2026_08_06: HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) OCP standard released by SK Hynix + SanDisk at FMS 2026 (08-03). 512GB/stack, 8-16x capacity vs HBM per stack, 0.4-3.0TB/s. First AI-inferencing samples early 2027 -- announcement-stage, not revenue-stage.

themes.name: AI capex financing structure
themes.watch: circular/vendor financing, SPVs, supplier equity stakes in customers, datacentre debt
themes.live_2026_07_28: Nvidia weighing $250bn guarantee for an OpenAI datacentre, part of >$750bn of deals. Goldman: circular revenue could be dilutive to the multiple.
themes.live_2026_07_30: Strengthened by MSFT Azure beat 7/29 rebutting capex-financing-without-revenue fear
themes.live_2026_07_31: MSFT FQ beat (Azure) is the named catalyst for both the 07-30 SMH +6.9% US rally and the 07-31 Asia melt-up (SOX +8% overnight read-through). Reinforces the 07-29 de-escalation of the circular-financing fear theme.

themes.name: Hyperscaler capex guidance
themes.watch: MSFT/GOOG/AMZN/META capex raises or cuts, datacentre deferrals
themes.live_2026_07_31: Same MSFT capex-beat driver as theme 3; no new hyperscaler guidance found beyond the 07-29 MSFT print.

themes.name: Policy & export controls

themes.name: Asian session leadership
themes.watch: KOSPI/TAIEX/Nikkei overnight moves >=3% and their named cause
themes.live_2026_07_28: KOSPI -10.84% (circuit breaker), TAIEX -4.65%, Nikkei -3.95%. KOSPI -34% in 25 days after a 300% spike.
themes.live_2026_07_31: KOSPI +17.9% (record single-day), TAIEX +7.98%, Nikkei +4.03%. Recovers ~half of the prior -17% three-session/-34% 25-day drawdown. Named causes: MSFT capex beat (primary/structural), SK Hynix Q2 print (mixed), SK Group Chairman's symbolic 3,620-share insider buy (immaterial, ~0.0005% of float). Short-covering/oversold bounce, not resolution of the CXMT structural threat.
themes.live_2026_08_03: KOSPI -5.17% intraday, Samsung/SK Hynix -6/-9%, brief sub-8,000 halt. TAIEX +0.54%, Nikkei -1.13% -- confirms 07-31 was a leverage-fueled overshoot now mean-reverting, isolated to KOSPI/chipmakers, not a regional risk-off event.

factor_catalysts.headline: SK Hynix and SanDisk release first HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) OCP standard at FMS 2026
